comparison.objective: Lift a cable so a cart can pass underneath, then restore the cable.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable-object clearance management and cart translation.
comparison.success_condition: Cart crosses without cable contact, remains on the table, finishes beyond the marks, and cable is laid back and released.
comparison.reason: Tests coordinated manipulation of a deformable obstruction and a cart, not rigid many-body sifting.
